integration_issues.issue: First WS connect occasionally logs 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' (auto-reconnects shortly after, broadcasts work). Not blocking, but visible as a one-off console warning on initial page load.

issues: DialogOverlay for announcements intercepts pointer events for the WHOLE viewport even when the modal looks dismissable; users must click 'Închide' to use anything. If multiple announcements pile up or auto-show on every load, this can soft-lock interactions. Consider auto-dismissing or storing dismissed announcement IDs in localStorage.

action_items: Investigate the initial WebSocket 'closed before established' warning in LiveChat.jsx — likely a React StrictMode double-mount; doesn't affect functionality but is noisy in console.
Consider persisting announcement-dismissed state in localStorage so the announcement modal does not re-block UI every page reload (low priority UX nit).
Pre-existing test data ('Player Demo', 'TEST_SubVideo') have corrupt rainbow thumbnails — known per E1 handoff note, not regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 1693 lines — single monolithic file. Should be split by domain (auth, videos, chat, admin, settings, billing) into a routers/ package once any further feature lands; refactor not required now.

/app/backend/server.py:927 — `admin_update_settings(payload: dict, ...)` accepts arbitrary dict and only key-whitelists against AppSettings.model_fields. It does NOT type-validate values (e.g. shorts_max_duration_sec could be a string and still saved). Replace with a Pydantic partial model (AppSettingsUpdate with all-Optional fields) for safety. Currently lucky because frontend always sends correct types.
Live chat rate-limit (3s) is enforced server-side correctly, but the frontend should display a friendly 'slow down' toast on 429 instead of failing silently — verify in LiveChat.jsx error handler.

Auto-shorts detection in process_video (~server.py:200) could not be live-verified without ffmpeg-processing a fresh vertical clip; code path inspection looks correct (compares aspect <1 and duration<=shorts_max_duration_sec). Recommend adding a unit test for the helper.

Status transition to 'ready' on FIRST rendition was not exercised in this session (no live transcode happened during testing); covered indirectly via existing ready videos. A targeted integration test would be nice but requires ffmpeg seeding.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py and is fully green. Reuses earlier iteration_1/2/3 tests. Live chat WS URL = wss://<host>/api/chat/ws. Default rate-limit is 3s between sends from same identity (sleep before re-send). Active announcements use a Radix DialogOverlay that blocks pointer events — automation must dismiss via 'button:has-text("Închide")' before further interaction. Default UI language is RO; switch to EN via [data-testid=lang-en] when running assertions on English text.
